I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread: the main contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Where it came from:** On 20 Aug 2025, Dana posted in #north-team that Thea had reported the duplicate door 6 arrivals on the morning shift. The same trailer had two 06:30 check-ins: one from the kiosk and one that dispatch added by hand. Dana was handling the issue on our side.
- **Second source:** The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

I only used sources Ilse can see herself: #north-team, which she's a member of, and public brain notes. I also checked the Quarrendon account file folder, but it has no files I can read.
